index_title: Orbit-safe matrices and one normalized relative rooted MI witness
scope: Candidate private B028: four orbit-safe packet lemmas, unsafe multi-packet transport and the normalized relative MI construction. The local parametric moving-reading proof applies to ANY h with the explicit original-family axioms and is then instantiated with the augmented safe selector restricted to original H. Ordinary EPPA is assumed ONLY for Age(Q/E); no EPPA of Q, same-rank owner master, raw SAP, group section or global rooted theorem is imported. B027 retains its published-HKN/pending local Lean-adapter qualification.
scope_explanation: statement and proof. Pure finite action, actual absolute/named closure, strong closed-S input, supplied fixed decoder and lower-quotient EPPA have distinct dependency branches.

assumptions.name: Actual symmetric-original homogeneous source
assumptions.statement: Q is nonempty transitive homogeneous in a FINITE complete symmetric binary language with actual equality-inclusive RAW orbitals and commutation of invariant endorelations. No SAP of the original real age, NR2, EPPA or safety is part of this premise.

assumptions.name: Original semantic homomorphic CCO
assumptions.statement: Q has semantic homomorphic CCO. Actual owner/coordinate equivalences used for RAW joint lifting are FULL RAW EXACT; inheritance and exactness are retained explicitly. This does not imply a completed global EPPA theorem.

assumptions.name: Infinite normalized one-direction source and exact coarse owner
assumptions.statement: Q is infinite with NO nonidentity finite-class full exact invariant equivalence and exactly ONE minimal infinite equivalence E in the FULL invariant lattice. Its actual exactness is derived from minimalcut; F=F_Q is the greatest finite-class invariant equivalence and need not itself be exact or Id. H is an ACTUAL FULL RAW EXACT invariant equivalence with E<=H; H=E or Top is allowed. R_E=F, thinness and absolute unary closure are derived, not substituted assumptions.

assumptions.name: Given original strong absolute closed-S amalgamation
assumptions.statement: S_Q is a GIVEN set of ORIGINAL diversity atom names strongly amalgamating every finite ABSOLUTELY real-acl_Q-closed complete induced span, including empty base. S_Q is not assumed invariant under unilateral thin translations. No nonempty typed orbit-safe palette or all-span transversal safe amalgamation is assumed before it is proved.

assumptions.name: Ordinary EPPA ONLY in the fine quotient
assumptions.statement: Age(Q/E) has ordinary EPPA. This is the sole age-level EPPA premise in B028. It is applied to the fine owner source X=Q/E, never to Q or a same-rank rooted/owner-master theorem.

assumptions.name: Current actual RAW-provider countability
assumptions.statement: Countability is retained where the currently prepared actual RAW/joint exact quotient providers are instantiated. Pure finite regular-action, selector-parameter, row correction and orbit-trim calculations do not independently use countability.

assumptions.name: Original finite input, entire coarse witness and requests
assumptions.statement: A0 subset Q is finite NONEMPTY. B subset Q/H is finite induced, contains pi_H(A0), is an ordinary EPPA witness for that projection, has Gamma_B*pi_H(A0)=B for Gamma_B=FULL Aut(B), and is closed under the greatest finite-class equivalence of the actual quotient Q/H. A request (p,gamma) is any original-language partial automorphism p:A0->A0 with gamma in Gamma_B and pi_H(p(x))=gamma pi_H(x) for every domain point. Retain EVERY (empty,gamma).

assumptions.name: Local displayed full-owner packet context
assumptions.statement: For the standalone orbit-safe/interface statements, U is a finite NONEMPTY G-closed actual E-owner set, N_U its entire real preimage, G the actual elementary abelian thin group REGULAR on real F-packets, and Gamma a supplied group of genuine U automorphisms with compatible pure owner lifts. Its owner action may be nonfree/nonfaithful; Gamma commutes with G and contains diagonal thin owners when readings are used. B025 supplies actual named homogeneity/closed SAP and primitive triangle-defined transversal with inflation. These displayed local data are CONSTRUCTED at C24-C30 for the final MI application, not new principal hypotheses of that construction.

imports.statement: Every genuine finite joint real/full-exact-owner partial isomorphism extends to ONE original automorphism. Check the ENTIRE supplied coarse/fine owner set and all mixed pairs before applying this contract; no lifting section is inferred.

definitions.name: Actual fine and coarse owners
definitions.statement: An E-owner is an actual class [x]_E; H-owners are [x]_H, with E<=H. Retain full canonical actual quotient colours and mixed orbitals, including logical equality.

definitions.statement: F=F_Q may be nonexact; E is the UNIQUE minimal infinite FULL direction, not a selected subset of minima. Normalization implies thin F; absolute unary closure and R_E=F are derived at C24.

definitions.statement: For the local statements U is finite nonempty G-closed actual E-owners and N_U=pi_E^{-1}(U), with projection pi:U->B whenever coarse data are supplied. Local statements are quantified over any such displayed input; final construction produces U in C26-C29.

definitions.statement: Gamma_tilde consists of EVERY alpha in FULL Aut(U) inducing some gamma in FULL Aut(B) on ENTIRE U. Since U->B is onto, gamma is unique. This is not merely the group generated by selected request extensions.

definitions.name: Regular real packets and full matrices
definitions.statement: A full packet Pi=F[x]={t_g x:g in G} has |G| DISTINCT real vertices, while its owner map g->gs may have nontrivial stabilizers. Full distinct-packet matrices are (g+h)a. H continues to denote the coarse equivalence, not a new stabilizer symbol.

definitions.statement: For a in P_st, a in S^G_st iff g a in ORIGINAL S_Q for EVERY g in G. This is equivalent to safety of the ENTIRE G-by-G matrix, and g=0 gives S^G subset S_Q. Nonemptiness is derived, not assumed.

The common base C=F[A] union T and factors F[L] union T,F[R] union T are complete original-Q structures and ABSOLUTELY closed via acl_Q=F[-]. Their images must be aligned on the WHOLE complete C before preserving actual owners is asserted.

definitions.statement: (p,gamma), with p an ORIGINAL fine-colour partial automorphism of A0 and gamma in Gamma_B, is compatible iff pi_H p=gamma pi_H on its domain. Empty p retains EVERY prescribed gamma. Entire B is part of the joint-lifting input.

claims.statement: For a real regular packet Pi=F[x] and origin owner s, its owner set is EXACTLY Gs and each t in Gs occurs |Stab_G(s)| times. Distinct group elements give distinct REAL points even when their owner tags agree.

I07 makes them absolutely acl_Q-closed. Relative acl_N-closedness alone is not substituted for the original closed-S premise.

Only now do fixed helper anchors in each actual E-owner force every factor point to retain its original owner by preserved E-incidences. Preserve every old fine colour and all strong/S conclusions.

claims.statement: A fine-colour embedding of a complete F-packet preserves its thin coordinates and has image the WHOLE actual F-class. Thus strong factor embeddings cannot put two opposite off-base packets into one F-class. Every new cross t_g x,t_h y is an off-base pair and has colour in S_Q; (g+h)col(x,y) in S_Q for all g,h proves the origin edge lies in S^G. This gives strong S^G-amalgamation of EVERY finite complete typed span, and two singleton factors over empty base derive each S^G_st NONEMPTY.

Original exact restrictions Dprime=D intersect({c}*bar A), Aprime=A intersect(bar D*{c}) contain a,b; individual heredity preserves them and both c-support conditions hold. Apply C11 with {c}: T(a,b,c), with NO relation g+k=ell. Thus any D10 selector, including h_(S^G)|H, supplies the B024 reading contract.

Every transported conservative reading at z,w returns (z+w)c_ij independently of its parameter. No original singleton is recoloured.

For any fixed full-row reservoir with the given injective origin certificate, C14-C17 give safety of every originally missing actual matrix for all rows/parameters/endpoint shifts while every structural extension/legal correction acts on this SAME decoder.

claims.statement: If an all-non-S clique Z meets >=2 actual packets, C16 forbids two distinct rows over one structural index and forbids any unrecorded pair of touched structural indices. Thus each touched i has ONE row f_i and the touched index set J is a recorded clique with >=2 indices.

claims.statement: Take every FULL structural packet over J, including all complete recorded matrices. Unary closure keeps each packet in one side of a free split and recorded edges join every pair, so the WHOLE closed substructure is irreducible. There is no locality/size bound on J or Z in this faithfulness step.

Its irreducible faithfulness supplies ONE structural Gamma automorphism s carrying the whole C20 substructure into that Aplus. Its actual regular real packet coordinates uniquely give s(i,z)=(sigma i,z+b_i); do not recover b_i from owner labels. This uses the existing reservoir contract, not another HKN application.

claims.statement: alpha_C preserves fine colours and full-packet bijections, so its image Z is still unsafe and meets >=2 actual packets. Any point in padding would have a safe edge to another touched packet by D13, contradiction. Hence alpha_C(Z) subset F[A0]. No selected-root or single-packet conclusion is asserted here.

I07 gives ABSOLUTE acl_Q=F[-]; I05/I06 give the actual regular thin G. No EPPA or S is used.

I01 gives one original lift, whose F-domain saturation induces a partial E-owner map on U0 compatible with gamma. No ordinary EPPA of Q or coherent choices are used.

Original centrality I06 then makes its restriction an automorphism of U=G[U1], retaining alpha and exact gamma. No centrality in an arbitrary quotient Aut group is assumed.

claims.statement: Define D04 on entire U. Onto U->B makes its coarse component unique and a homomorphism. C28 supplies lifts of every request; empty requests for EVERY gamma make Gamma_tilde->Gamma_B onto. For EVERY alpha in FULL Gamma_tilde, lift alpha union gamma on ENTIRE U union B by I01/I02; original centrality proves alpha(gu)=g alpha(u). The actual diagonal thin owners lie in Gamma_tilde. No section or faithful owner action is assumed.

Restrict to F[dom p] to obtain a full-packet partial map of Aplus with range in F[A0] and EXACT language component gamma_tilde. An arbitrary independent extension of p is insufficient.
